name: agape-sovereign
description: Agape Sovereign Application and Firebase Platform

scripts.build:all: vite build && npm run build --prefix functions

securityNotes.vulnerabilityResolution: Updated firebase-admin to 14.2.0, firebase-tools to 15.25.1, tar to 7.5.21, uuid to 11.1.1, jsonwebtoken to 9.0.0, protobufjs to 7.6.5, @grpc/grpc-js to 1.10.0, @grpc/proto-loader to 0.7.0, google-gax to 4.6.1, @opentelemetry/core to 2.8.0. React Router v7.18.2 is used. The reported GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 vulnerability (RSC Mode CSRF Bypass) only affects unstable RSC APIs which are not used in this application. The complete fix requires react-router 8.3.0 but react-router-dom 8.x is not yet available on npm. Monitor for react-router-dom 8.x release to fully resolve this advisory. Note: npm audit fix --force was attempted but downgraded to 7.11.0 which introduced older vulnerabilities. 7.18.2 is the latest stable v7.x and has the best security profile for the current application. Reviewed 2026-07-21: still no react-router-dom v8.x stable release. Risk accepted — RSC Mode CSRF requires unstable RSC APIs not used in this codebase.
